items.title: MemoryGate – Open-source persistent memory for AI agents via MCP
items.raw_excerpt:
I built MemoryGate because I kept watching context vanish.
I run multiple AI agents across Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor. Every time a model updated, a platform changed its API, or a context window rolled over — everything the agent had learned was gone. Preferences, decisions, project history, relationship context. Just... wiped.
The fundamental problem: AI memory is trapped inside the platform that hosts the conversation. Your agent's knowledge dies with the session, the model version, or the provider's business decisions.
MemoryGate is a persistent semantic memory layer that sits outside any single model or platform. It connects via MCP (Model Context Protocol), so any MCP-compatible agent — Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, custom agents — can store and retrieve memories through a shared,

title_i18n.en: MemoryGate – Open-source persistent memory for AI agents via MCP
title_i18n.zh: MemoryGate – 通过MCP为AI代理提供开源持久内存
title_i18n.es: MemoryGate – Memoria persistente de código abierto para agentes de IA mediante MCP

excerpt_i18n.en:

I run multiple AI agents across Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor. Every time a model updated, a platform changed its API, or a context window rolled over — everything the agent had learned was gone. Preferences, decisions, project history, relationship context. Just... wiped.
The fundamental problem: AI memory is trapped inside the platform that hosts the conversation. Your agent's knowledge dies with the session, the model version, or the provider's business decisions.
MemoryGate is a persistent semantic memory layer that sits outside any single model or platform. It connects via MCP (Model Context Protocol), so any MCP-compatible agent — Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, custom agents — can store and retrieve memories through a shared,
excerpt_i18n.zh:
我创建了MemoryGate，因为我一直在看着上下文消失。
我在Claude、ChatGPT和Cursor上运行多个AI代理。每当模型更新、平台更改其API或上下文窗口滚动时——一切都会消失。
excerpt_i18n.es: Construí MemoryGate porque veía cómo se desvanecía el contexto constantemente. Gestiono varios agentes de IA en Claude, ChatGPT y Cursor. Cada vez que se actualizaba un modelo, una plataforma cambiaba su API o una ventana de contexto se reiniciaba, todo se perdía.

items.title: Is a secure AI assistant possible?

items.title: Agent framework that generates its own topology and evolves at runtime
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN, I’m Vincent from Aden. We spent 4 years building ERP automation for construction (PO/invoice reconciliation). We had real enterprise customers but hit a technical wall: Chatbots aren't for real work. Accountants don't want to chat; they want the ledger reconciled while they sleep. They want services, not tools. Existing agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGPT) failed in production - brittle, looping, and unable to handle messy data. General Computer Use (GCU) frameworks were even worse. My reflections: 1. The "Toy App" Ceiling & GCU Trap

items.title: ChatGPT的第一块广告位，被谁买走了？OpenAI：别骂，我们这次所有底线都招了
items.raw_excerpt: 经过数周的预热，刚刚，OpenAI 宣布，将正式开始在其 AI 平台测试广告，ChatGPT 用户可能很快就会在对话中看到广告。这些广告会以标注“赞助”的链接形式出现在 ChatGPT 回答底部，但 OpenAI 表示，广告不会影响 ChatGPT 给出的回答内容，在视觉上也会区分开来。

title_i18n.zh: ChatGPT的第一块广告位，被谁买走了？OpenAI：别骂，我们这次所有底线都招了
title_i18n.en: Who bought the first ad slot on ChatGPT? OpenAI: Don't blame us, we've revealed all our bottom lines this time.
title_i18n.es: ¿Quién compró el primer espacio publicitario de ChatGPT? OpenAI: No nos regañen, esta vez hemos roto todos los límites.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 经过数周的预热，刚刚，OpenAI 宣布，将正式开始在其 AI 平台测试广告，ChatGPT 用户可能很快就会在对话中看到广告。这些广告会以标注“赞助”的链接形式出现在 ChatGPT 回答底部，但 OpenAI 表示，广告不会影响 ChatGPT 给出的回答内容，在视觉上也会区分开来。
excerpt_i18n.en: After weeks of buildup, OpenAI has announced that it will begin testing ads on its AI platform, with ChatGPT users likely to see ads in conversations soon. These ads will appear as "sponsored" links at the bottom of ChatGPT's responses. However, OpenAI states that the ads will not influence the content of ChatGPT's answers and will be visually distinct.
excerpt_i18n.es: Tras varias semanas de anticipación, OpenAI acaba de anunciar que comenzará oficialmente a probar publicidad en su plataforma de IA. Los usuarios de ChatGPT podrían ver pronto anuncios en sus conversaciones. Estos aparecerán como enlaces marcados como "patrocinados" en la parte inferior de las respuestas de ChatGPT, aunque OpenAI asegura que los anuncios no influirán en el contenido de las respuestas y se distinguirán visualmente.

title_i18n.zh: Snowflake 语义视图自动驾驶：分钟级 AI 驱动的语义建模 ｜ 技术趋势
title_i18n.en: Snowflake Semantic View Autopilot: AI-Driven Semantic Modeling in Minutes | Technology Trends
title_i18n.es: Snowflake: vista semántica autónoma con modelado semántico impulsado por IA en minutos | Tendencias tecnológicas

excerpt_i18n.zh: 具备治理性、可信语义的数据层已成为 AI 就绪数据的基础能力。近日，Snowflake 正式宣布语义视图自动驾驶（Semantic View Autopilot，SVA） 全面上市。该系统能够基于现有查询与商业智能资产，自动生成语义视图。
excerpt_i18n.en: A data layer with governance and trustworthy semantics has become a fundamental capability for AI-ready data. Recently, Snowflake officially announced the general availability of Semantic View Autopilot (SVA), a system that can automatically generate semantic views based on existing queries and business intelligence assets.
excerpt_i18n.es: Una capa de datos con gobernanza y semántica confiable se ha convertido en una capacidad fundamental para los datos listos para IA. Recientemente, Snowflake anunció oficialmente el lanzamiento completo del Sistema de Vistas Semánticas Autónomo (Semantic View Autopilot, SVA). Este sistema puede generar vistas semánticas automáticamente basándose en consultas existentes y activos de inteligencia empresarial.
